text: The plan-status harness runs in SIT for the run of record and UAT for the acceptance run against the published contracts, seeds case "RW-2026-000310", account "A-0310", plan "TDR-SYN-0310" and RESTRUCTURE version "RES-2026.12" through the owning contracts or the section 12.8 fakes, records one evidence report per run keyed by story and business date, passes only when every owned criterion is green, and reads the plan status section through the gateway-bff composite case-record route that RWB-PLT-N001-CON owns.
why: The sources fix the owners, the operations, the events, the rules and every legacy value but give no harness repository or environment, no seeding mechanism, no evidence format or retention, no pass or fail gate and no composite route path or merge order, and the run cannot wait for a decision on them.
read: Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-11, DP-13 and DP-19, R7.2 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 14, 41 and 44; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slides 11, 13, 14, 15 and 28; legacy RWB-E2-002 sections 3, 12 and 13
confirm: Integration lead, QA lead and platform edge owner at the wave 2 entry check
impact: The harness runs on the section 12.8 fakes and the ACE common module stub from Day 1 and proves the plan-status journey across the five services before the I stories land; only the real-service cut-over, the composite route detail and the evidence sign-off wait for the confirmation.
